page.notes: Hebrew letters and points are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; the Hebrew forms and some final-letter shapes are doubtful, especially the Dages and the final forms of כ, מ and נ. The Hebrew letter immediately before "Pe" at the foot is printed as a catchword-like heading and is shown as a paragraph. The Hebrew glyphs in the Latin lines are approximated and should be checked against the scan.
